Running Pace Calculator

Solve for running pace, finish time or distance — with one-tap presets for 5K, 10K, half and full marathon.

–
Pace

Assumes a perfectly even pace from start to finish.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose what to solve: pace, time or distance.
  2. Enter the two values you know.
  3. Tap a preset (5K, 10K, half, marathon) to fill the distance instantly.
  4. Read the computed result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I use miles instead of kilometers?

Yes — use the pace-unit selector to switch between min/km and min/mi. Distances also convert between km, miles and meters.

Does it assume an even pace?

It assumes a perfectly even pace from start to finish. Hills, wind and fatigue mean real races vary.

What do the preset buttons do?

They set the distance field for you: 5K = 5 km, 10K = 10 km, half marathon = 21.0975 km, marathon = 42.195 km. Then solve for pace or time as usual.
